key_decisions.decision: Preserves both divine-name forms and the recurring thanksgiving formula.
Preserves failure of understanding and memory and the sea's Hebrew name.
Takes leanness as bodily affliction without spiritualizing the harm.
Follows their glory and preserves the diminishing grass-eating image.
Keeps the threatened destruction and defensive-breach intercession image.
Makes oath gesture intelligible while preserving the falling judgment.
Retains falling as well as scattering, without silently emending the verb.
Leaves the referent of the dead open and retains cultic attachment.
Keeps decisive intervention without recasting the violent episode as prayer.
Leaves whose spirit unresolved while identifying the rash speaker.
Retains the destructive command without euphemism.
Preserves both sexes of children and the named recipients.
Retains repeated blood, children, recipients, and land pollution.
Preserves the sexual infidelity metaphor rather than generalizing misconduct.
Preserves covenant remembrance and relenting, with read-form abundance.
Preserves the book-closing blessing, communal response, and short name.
